about.tagline: I build applications. I integrate AI. I automate the rest.
about.summary: Full Stack developer focused on real architecture and infrastructure. I build complete applications, integrate AI, and automate processes. Actively training in cybersecurity and networking.
about.diff_panel_subtitle: I do more than develop. I understand, build, and improve real systems.
about.tech_1: Full Stack without friction: React on the front, Laravel or Node.js on the back, from idea to production.
about.tech_2: APIs & integrations: REST, auth with JWT/OAuth, external services, Firebase.
about.tech_3: Real infrastructure: Docker, Nginx, Linux VPS, Raspberry Pi, Synology NAS.
about.tech_4: AI in production: Gemini API, prompt engineering, rate limiting, fallbacks.
about.tech_5: Automation: n8n, no-code/low-code flows integrated into real projects.
about.tech_6: WordPress & Divi: corporate websites, landing pages and custom web pages with autonomous client management.
about.story_lead: Understanding, building, and pushing ideas until they truly work.
about.story_intro: My path blends pedagogy, technical curiosity, and real hands-on work. I have always needed to understand how systems work and push them to a point where they truly solve problems.
about.story_short_1: I started in Pedagogy, learning how to structure complexity. Later I realized I did not just want to understand systems. I wanted to build them.
about.story_short_2: Forums, servers, Raspberry Pi, Docker, and automations shaped my foundation long before formal training. DAW gave that practice structure.
about.story_short_3: Today I build full stack applications, automate processes, and integrate AI with one clear idea: everything should work properly in production. I also learn cybersecurity and networking best practices to build more secure and robust systems.
about.story_short_4: Post-DAW Cybersecurity Specialization Course (Entornos TI). Builds on a 350h MOOC (UMA) and the Cisco CCST certification currently in progress.
about.story_p1:
I did not end up in development by accident.
I have always needed to understand how things work from the inside.
about.story_p2: I started by studying Pedagogy, where I learned to analyze, structure, and explain complex ideas until they make sense. Later I realized that, beyond understanding systems, I needed to build them.
about.story_p3: From a very young age I explored technology on my own: forums, servers, Raspberry Pi, Docker, and automations. DAW gave formal structure to years of hands-on practice and confirmed that what drives me is not just programming, but creating complete systems.
about.story_p4: Today I build full stack applications, automate processes, configure infrastructure, and integrate AI into production with one clear idea: everything has to work for real.
about.story_p5: When I started DAW I wasn't starting from zero: I was giving formal structure to something I'd been doing for years. That's when I understood that what I do isn't just programming. It's building complete systems.
about.story_p6: Today I build full stack applications knowing what happens after deploy. I configure infrastructure, automate processes, integrate AI into production, and make sure everything works even when no one is watching.
about.story_p7: I'm not interested in something that ‘looks like’ it works. I want it to actually work.
about.diff_detail: I don't deliver something that only looks like it works. I pay attention to what others miss: edges, errors, real-world cases. It's not perfectionism — it's standard.
about.diff_selflearner: I learn it before I need it. Docker, Linux, AI, infrastructure... I research, test, break things, and fix them.
about.diff_pedagogy: I don't just build systems. I make them understandable, maintainable, and clear for real people.
about.diff_ai: AI in production, not in demos. Gemini integrated with rate limiting, fallbacks, and error handling.
about.diff_n8n: I don't just build the app — I automate what runs behind it. n8n flows that replace repetitive work and connect systems that wouldn't talk to each other otherwise.

about.cta_desc: Available for projects where technical quality and real execution are a priority.
about.yt_desc: I share real technical projects, game servers, AI, 3D printing, and more. A way to see how I work, communicate and solve problems.
about.bio_p1: Technology has been part of my life for years. Even before starting my training as a developer, I was already experimenting with assembling home servers and configuring my own environments to understand how systems worked on the inside.
about.bio_p4: For years I have also worked with 3D printing. My first printers lacked connectivity, so I configured my own servers using Raspberry Pi to monitor them remotely over WAN. These types of personal projects have reinforced my ability to research, test, document, and solve technical problems autonomously.
about.bio_p6: I share part of my projects and technical processes on my own channel, which has allowed me to develop documentation and technical communication skills, key abilities for working in a team and transmitting solutions clearly.
about.bio_p7: I define myself as a creative, restless, and persistent person. I like technical challenges and finishing what I start. When something blocks me, I investigate until I understand and solve it. That combination of curiosity and constancy is the engine of my professional evolution.
about.bio_p8: My goal is to continue growing within web development and systems integration, providing real value in projects where technical quality and continuous improvement are a priority.
